I answered Marcus in a thread in #north-team: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

There are two sources, and Marcus can see both:
- Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 on the morning shift.
- The public North cheat sheet lists Thea as Quarrendon Freight Lines' main contact.

A contact name isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't use anything from Dana's DMs.
